mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy
failure_condition: If the combined condition does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS QoQ > GDPC1 QoQ does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a supply-side shock and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined condition does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
